svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Generate digital art with AI and embed it in blog posts or social media posts, despite the
stakeholder not being a skilled artist. → Create multimedia content with AI assistance fo
r blog posts and social media posts.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Have the AI assistant process and output standardized formats such as JSON or XML in addit
ion to natural language for coding tasks. → Use AI assistance for coding or programming ta
sks at work.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Receive succinct responses from the AI assistant rather than verbose conversational ones.
→ Improve the stakeholder's productivity by using AI assistant tools.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Have the AI assistant hold memory or history of previous interactions to provide context a
bout the stakeholder's requirements. → Not have to repeat the stakeholder's context in eve
ry query or conversation with the AI assistant.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Fully automate certain pipelines with AI assistance without needing a human in the loop. →
Improve the stakeholder's productivity by using AI assistant tools.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Have AI assistant output be factually accurate rather than hallucinated. → Fully automate
certain pipelines with AI assistance without needing a human in the loop.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Have hallucinations detected and corrected, which the stakeholder sees as requiring a tech
nological breakthrough and for which no solution is offered. → Have AI assistant output be
factually accurate rather than hallucinated.
